subject.title: fix(build): fall back to tsx for build TypeScript scripts

question: Is the build-all-only fallback scope acceptable for this PR, or should no-native-TypeScript compatibility be required for direct package scripts before merge?
rationale: The patch is source- and proof-supported for the reported `pnpm build` path, but deciding whether to expand compatibility beyond build-all is a scope choice rather than a mechanical defect in this branch.

options.title: Land narrow build-all fallback
options.body: Merge this PR after normal checks because it fixes the reported `pnpm build` failure without changing direct package scripts.

options.title: Expand before merge
options.body: Ask for the same fallback contract to cover direct package scripts that still call native strip-types.

options.title: Pause or close
options.body: Do not land the fallback if maintainers do not want `tsx` as the build-all compatibility path.

recommendation.title: Land narrow build-all fallback
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after normal checks because it fixes the reported `pnpm build` failure without changing direct package scripts.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee and has recent history on build-all fallback and package build gates.
